title: H_280 independent distinction kernel vs canonical IIT4 (stdlib consciousness/iit4_distinction) cross-validation
method: build a state-by-node TPM from H_280's ces_tpm_node (the ε-floored disc/weak/integrated substrate, all-ON state, ring, ε=1e-6) and feed the BYTE-IDENTICAL array to BOTH the H_280 kernel (ces_distinction) and the canonical engine (stdlib consciousness/iit4_distinction.distinction); compare per-mechanism distinction membership, distinction-count, and Σφ_d ordering. Secondary anchor: canonical-native deterministic ECA rule 204 (copy=disconnected) vs 232 (majority=integrated).
engine_math_note: canonical iit4_phi_at fixes the specified state z* once (intrinsic_difference vs unconstrained) then minimizes p(z*)log2(p(z*)/q(z*)) over partitions; H_280 ces_id re-maximizes max_x p log2(p/q) per partition then minimizes. Both are MIP-min of an ID-style measure; absolute φ can differ, so the cross-validation target is the distinction SET + directional verdict, NOT byte-equal Σφ_d.

deterministic_eca_anchor.weak_rung: N/A — couple=0.5 is genuinely stochastic, no deterministic ECA equivalent
deterministic_eca_anchor.sum_phi_d_direction_integrated_gt_discon: FAIL (Σφ_d NOT a monotone integration proxy: 204 Σφ_d 3.000000 > 232 Σφ_d 2.026359)
deterministic_eca_anchor.big_phi_direction_integrated_gt_disconne: PASS (THE correct integration discriminator: 204 big-Φ 0.000000 < 232 big-Φ 4.867130)

root_cause.bug: H_280 ces_phi_mech_purview only counts partitions that sever an M-to-Z directed link (cuts_link guard, lib_ces.hexa ~L482); a singleton mechanism over a singleton purview has no such cut, so found=false and phi returns 0.0. The canonical engine instead includes the mechanism-to-empty partition (purview becomes unconstrained), yielding phi = ID(constrained vs unconstrained) ~ 1.0. Consequence: H_280 spuriously zeroes every independent self-copy cell's phi_d, so the disconnected substrate gets 0 distinctions when the IIT 4.0 ground truth (and the M6-calibrated canonical) gives 3 distinctions each with phi_d~1.
root_cause.impact: H_280's headline 'integrated Σφ_d > disconnected Σφ_d' was an ARTIFACT of this singleton bug zeroing the disconnected baseline. The canonical engine shows Σφ_d is NOT monotone with integration (disconnected Σφ_d 3.0 > integrated 2.03 at n=3). The genuine integration direction is preserved at the big-Φ level (204 big-Φ=0 < 232 big-Φ>0) and via relations, NOT raw Σφ_d. H_280's directional conclusion happens to point the same way but for the wrong reason; its F280.3 'disconnected -> φ_d=0' faithfulness anchor was a mistaken IIT 4.0 expectation (it conflated no-system-integration with no-distinctions).

falsifier: F-XVAL-1: H_280 kernel distinction-membership + count + Σφ_d ordering AGREE with canonical iit4_distinction on the shared ladder. PASS = independent corroboration; FAIL = canonical (M6-calibrated) is authoritative.
tier: GREEN-NUMERICAL cross-validation (two independent IIT 4.0 distinction kernels on byte-identical TPM input); empirical interpretation SPECULATION-FENCED (g5)
